class.name: ResourceLoadResult
class.brief_description: The result of a resource load: the resource, or the error code and the loader's message.

members.member: [constant OK] if the load succeeded. Otherwise [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] if there is no file at [member path], [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] if the loaded resource is not of the requested type hint, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [method ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_result] was called without a request, or the code returned by the loader, for example [constant ERR_FILE_CORRUPT] or [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR].

Empty if the load succeeded. Otherwise the errors printed while the resource and its dependencies were loaded, one per line and oldest first (at most 16 lines), including those printed on worker threads of a threaded load. If nothing was printed, for example because a loader only returned an [enum Error] code, it is the name of [member error] followed by the path.
[code]true[/code] if the load succeeded and [member resource] holds the resource; the same as [code]error == OK[/code].

The path that was loaded, resolved as [ResourceLoader] resolves it: a [code]uid://[/code] path becomes the path of its file, a relative path is prefixed with [code]res://[/code], and a path inside the project is localized.
The loaded resource, the same (cached) instance that [method ResourceLoader.load] returns. [code]null[/code] if the load failed.
